heroSummary: The Bambu Lab A1 Mini handles Overture TPU 95A out of the box using its responsive direct drive extruder without needing nozzle or enclosure upgrades. Printing is capped at a calculated safe max speed of 54 mm/s to strictly honor the 4.5 mm³/s volumetric flow limit and prevent filament buckling.
bedSurfaceRecommendation: Textured PEI Plate with PVP Glue Stick as a release agent
slicerTweaks: Set Maximum Volumetric Speed to 4.5 mm³/s in the Filament settings to prevent extruder gear jamming.
Enable Avoid Crossing Walls in Quality settings to minimize stringing and oozing across travel paths.
Disable Retraction Wipe or set it to 0 mm to avoid grinding the flexible filament against the drive gears.
Set First Layer Speed to 25 mm/s and Outer Wall Speed to 40 mm/s for optimal surface quality and layer adhesion.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Extruder clogs and filament loops out of the drive gears
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Volumetric speed exceeding 4.5 mm³/s or excessively rapid retractions pushing the flexible filament out of the constrained path.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Clamp Max Volumetric Speed to 4.5 mm³/s in OrcaSlicer and lower Retraction Speed to 30 mm/s.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Severe fine stringing and surface bubbling across perimeters
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: TPU is highly hygroscopic and has absorbed ambient moisture, generating steam in the hotend.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Dry the filament in a dedicated dryer at 55°C for 6 to 8 hours before printing directly from a drybox.

troubleshootingMatrix.issue: Print fuses permanently to the build plate and tears PEI coating
troubleshootingMatrix.rootCause: Direct adhesion of molten TPU to PEI creates an excessively strong chemical and mechanical bond.
troubleshootingMatrix.exactFix: Apply an even layer of liquid glue or standard glue stick across the Textured PEI Plate to act as a sacrificial release interface.

faq.question: Can I feed Overture TPU 95A through the Bambu Lab AMS Lite?
faq.answer: No, flexible filaments like TPU 95A will bind and tangle inside the AMS Lite feeder mechanisms; load it using an external spool holder mounted directly to the toolhead.

faq.question: Why is print speed restricted to 54 mm/s on a high-speed machine?
faq.answer: Flexible filaments experience severe backpressure and buckle if forced through the hotend faster than their 4.5 mm³/s melt rate allows.

faq.question: Does Overture TPU 95A require a hardened steel nozzle on the A1 Mini?
faq.answer: No, standard TPU 95A is non-abrasive, so the stock stainless steel nozzle operates reliably without abnormal wear.

faq.question: Why is glue stick necessary if the bed is textured PEI?
faq.answer: On PEI surfaces, TPU bonds so strongly that it can delaminate the PEI coating during removal; the glue stick functions as a release barrier rather than an adhesive.
